items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.

items.title: 28% increase in passports issued by the Italian Consulate in Dubai
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 28 LUG - The Consulate General of Italy in Dubai reports that in the first six months of 2026, it issued 1,340 passports, compared to 1,046 during the same period in 2025. This represents a 28% increase. “This increase,” explains the consulate, “did not occur in spite of the conflict, but rather because of the conflict.” Furthermore, the consular offices remained open throughout March to renew expiring passports and issue first passports to newborns. items.title: Italy 'books' SAFE loan of up to €14.9 billion, but EC says deal must be signed ASAP
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 28 - Deputy Premier and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said Tuesday that the government has reserved the right to take a loan from the EU's SAFE (Security Action for Europe) facility of up to 14.9 billion euros to invest in security and defence. items.title: Govt cuts diesel duties by 17 cents to help with rise in fuel costs
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 28 - A 17-cent cut in diesel duties that the government approved on Monday to help people cope with high fuel costs following the return of conflict in the Persian Gulf came into effect on Tuesday and will remain in place until August 6. The cut will cost the State around 125 million euro and should bring diesel prices in line with those for unleaded petrol, the duties of which have not been reduced.
